title: Flash8 re-theme polish P2/P3: convert ColorPicker + standardize accent blue to #009DFF + widget font/width nits
description: Visual audit follow-ups. (2) Standardize the ad-hoc accent blues to halo.haloBlue (#009DFF): replace #0099ff (TransformHandles.tsx), #0099cc/#2288cc/#1a6ea8 (SwatchesPanel.tsx + any others found via grep) — grep packages/authoring-ui/src for these and swap to the token where they mean 'accent/selection' (do NOT touch genuine content/data colors like layer outline swatches or System-C timeline colors). VERIFY against docs/30-flash8-ui-spec.md. Build+authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable). ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry. Scope: ColorPicker.tsx + the specific accent-blue files; keep edits minimal and accent-only.
